# Gem Solar

> Nigeria's premium solar panel installation company. We design, supply, and install residential and commercial solar energy systems across Lagos, Ibadan, Abuja, and Port Harcourt.

## About

Gem Solar is a Nigerian-owned solar installation company committed to delivering clean, reliable energy to homes and businesses across Nigeria. We specialize in end-to-end solar solutions — from site survey and system design through to installation, commissioning, and after-sales support.

## Services

- **Residential Solar Installation**: Rooftop solar systems for homes, engineered to eliminate NEPA/PHCN dependency
- **Commercial Solar Installation**: Large-scale solar arrays for businesses, factories, and commercial properties
- **Battery Storage Systems**: Inverter and battery backup solutions for 24/7 power reliability
- **Solar Products Supply**: High-efficiency solar panels, inverters, charge controllers, and accessories

## Service Areas

Lagos State, Oyo State (Ibadan), FCT Abuja, Rivers State (Port Harcourt), Ogun State, Osun State, and surrounding regions across Nigeria.

## Why Choose Gem Solar

- Over 18,000 solar architectures commissioned
- Average 94% electricity bill reduction after year one
- 2.3× faster ROI vs. industry average
- 25-year comprehensive warranty on all installations
- Flexible Naira financing options available
